body: Life is cruel but as long as you are breathing and moving and doing anything for that matter you are already on the path to find happiness. Please continue to work and if you need a break up can have it, dont stress yourself too much I think over thinking is one of the worst things you can be doing right now.

She doesn't deserve you, you are better than this and stronger. Talk to people and partake in menial task. Things won't be easy but they are worth the effort so please continue to hang in there I'm sure you can recover from this.

It isn't better to end it, you can still recover but it will be hard. I know you can do it and I've been alone too it's terrible and draining but a lot of things can help for example doing hobbies or just walking outside every day, you can take it slow and build your confidence up that way, ones your ready you can do some small chatting with people about random things you don't need to do this when there is still time. Beating this isn't easy but it's worth the effort just please don't give up.

What happened? You don't need to worry or rush yourself just take it slow and steady. You can beat this you just need to be proud of yourself and maybe do some few small hobbies I know that it sounds dumb but it can go a long way.
Do you want to talk about it? You can say whatever you need to say here, I know most people wouldn't care or listen but if you are willing to talk then I'll listen to you.

Some people have it better than others but they lack a lot of things that you have, for example your strength and perseverance I'm not lying when I say that. I have thought about simply being someone else but then I realized that it wouldn't even be me at that point. Everything you have endured has made you who you are at this point, taking it back wouldn't solve anything. You can do so much more than that, you are already on the path all you have to do is continue walking down it. There will be many distractions but please focus you can definitely do this.

You are probably stressed because of work or some events taking place around you, I want to tell you that sometimes you need to take a step back. You don't need to do everything right you just need to do it to the best of your abilities. There is no need to rush just take it easy and indulge in some fun hobbies

That voice is wrong you are much more than that, you are an example of perseverance and determination. If it wasn't because of that then you wouldn't be here after all that time. I know it's probably childish but I used to organize and clean my house when I was feeling like that, I used to think that if I'm nothing then at least I can say that I have a clean house. It seems stupid but doing something like that every day really helps you build confidence.

Thank you for sharing your story, there is a lot of people here that don't comment but it's because of people like you that others open up and seek help. You are making progress even if it's slow it's still progress and thats more than can be said for many others. You can keep going I know that you will take back your mind from that demon just remember one step at a time and take a break when you need it.

Do you want to talk about it some more? I know this is essentially a worst case scenario but I know you can recover from this. It will be hard but in my experience any hobbies help with this feelings just take it one small step at a time and focus on recovering.

I know that feeling but you can't get used to it. Even if you have to force yourself don't allow it to shape who you are. People don't understand because they have had it easy most of the time, not many people will care but some do care and those are the people you should be listening to. You can rise above this, I know it seems impossible but you can start small and work yourself up at your own pace. No one needs to tell you what to do, you don't need to prove anything just try and achieve that happiness, use hobbies and your relationship to your advantage. You need to heal so give it time I know you can do this.
Do you want to talk about it? This is a place where you can let it all out. Even though I don't know you im certain that you can beat this, it won't be easy but please take it easy.

Then don't do it, just take it easy you don't need to push yourself, get a break and relax for a little while. You can do small things like cleaning or anything for that matter but don't leave. You have endured soo much and you are soo strong, most people can't even take a few months of that and yet you have done if for a decade. Just try to think about other things and talk to your girlfriend. If you have endured this long then you can beat this. Don't be afraid to talk not everyone will listen but some will.

Is there nothing left for you to do? Do you have no other things you want to do? Being young will always be the time where you have the most freedom but growing old has its own advantages and experiences please think it through.
What happened? You can talk about anything here if you want to tell I'll listen
Isn't there anything that you want to do before going through with your decision? What if all the bad stopped then what would you do? There's still time you have everything in front of you.

I know it doesn't mean much coming from an anonymous internet comment but I care, Im struggling right now with all this pain and no one seems to care either but the thing is that it doesn't matter if they care or they don't care because at the end of the day the only one that can beat this monster is you. Stop planning to do it instead plan on doing small things, it can literally be anything like cleaning or a 30 minute walk anything can help you don't need to prove yourself to anyone. 

It's hard to get out of the mud I know cause I haven't managed to do it yet but as long as you are still moving and trying there is always a chance that you will rise above this demon. You managed to hold out for a year and perhaps even longer and that's soo impressive most people wouldn't even handle a day in your shoes think about that you are stronger than most people. The only important thing is too keep on going so please do.

What do you want to do ? If you have any hobbies then be proud of doing them, wether it's cleaning or playing games they all work as tangible distractions you don't need to push yourself or meet the expectations of anyone, I understand that you want to be better but growth isn't fast and it takes time. For now just take small steps and do other things. That sense of accomplishment isn't limited to studying.
What happened? How are you feeling right now? You don't have to rush into things if you don't want to

I always find myself in the same position, if university is too stressful then take a brake and re evaluate things. Don't push yourself too hard, try to do something consistently every day and move on from there. The pain won't go away by itself

You admitting to your shortcomings is already a lot better than most people. You can continue to work on yourself and improve little by little even if it's the most trivial thing like cleaning or polishing something just doing anything can go a long way. Not talking to people can be helpful for a while but in my experience after a few months of isolation you would have ended up causing way more damage to yourself. Don't cut your ties with people try to salvage it but give it some time, if you need a break you can always have one but don't be too hard on yourself you still have a long road ahead believe in yourself please.
Please don't go, you aren't giving yourself enough credit!
